# anecdotes_login_settings (Resource)

Manages the Anecdotes tenant's Login Methods settings (Administration > Settings). This is a singleton resource: there is exactly one login configuration per tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Login Settings is a singleton: exactly one instance manages the whole tenant's
# Login Methods configuration. Any attribute left unset here is not managed by
# Terraform and keeps whatever value the platform already has.
resource "anecdotes_login_settings" "this" {
  internal_users_login        = true
  auditors_login              = true
  external_stakeholders_login = false

  google_idp_enabled    = true
  microsoft_idp_enabled = false

  support_team_login = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auditors_login` (Boolean) Whether email/password login is permitted for auditors.
- `external_stakeholders_login` (Boolean) Whether email/password login is permitted for external stakeholders.
- `google_idp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether login via Google is enabled.
- `internal_users_login` (Boolean) Whether email/password login is permitted for internal users.
- `microsoft_idp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether login via Microsoft is enabled.
- `support_team_login` (Boolean) Whether the Anecdotes support team may log in to this tenant.
